title: red-pipeline reads the newest finished pipeline, which with every job manual is almost always one where nothing ran
goal: backlog.py red-pipeline and the query log's revert check read the newest pipeline of main in which a job actually ran (not one where every job is manual or skipped), count a job that timed out or got stuck (job_execution_timeout, stuck_or_timeout_failure) as red, and a filed bug's repro stays failing until that failure is fixed rather than until any later push; tests plant a red started pipeline followed by newer unstarted ones.
